column1: # Leak-scan allowlist — every row is one exception, with its reason and its expiry.
#   rule <TAB> path-glob <TAB> sha256:<12> <TAB> reason <TAB> expires YYYY-MM-DD
# Rules: a row matches one rule, one path glob, and one VALUE digest. A path glob may
# use `*`; the row is still value-pinned. A different value at the same path is still a
# finding, and there is no row without a digest.
# An expired row is a finding, so a debt cannot outlive its date. Delete the row
# when the value is gone; do not move the date forward without a reason here.
